## Problem and resulting behavior

Link the actual issue and relevant ADR/stage. Describe final behavior and preservation constraints; distinguish documentation plans from implemented behavior.

## Scope and evidence

- Stage and prerequisite exits:
- Changed source/config/docs and compatibility effects:
- Checks actually run and results:
- Physical environments, artifact SHA-256, source commit and evidence (or Not run with reason):
- Recovery and privacy impact:
- Independent review performed (or absent and why):
- Remaining blockers/risks and next eligible step:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Issue acceptance and preservation criteria covered; no unearned support claims
- [ ] Staged diff reviewed; no private diagnostics, credentials or generated payloads
- [ ] Applicable tests and documentation updated; skipped checks explicitly explained
- [ ] No unsupported identity widening, shared-action split, or policy execution
- [ ] Device/publication authorization matches the actual action
